title: Articles
heading: Stories beyond the microphone.
description: Discover the direction of Viking Legacy & Lore’s forthcoming articles: Viking history, Norse belief, archaeology and the people behind the sagas.
intro: A future home for thoughtful writing on the Viking world. The article collection is in preparation; the podcast archive is ready to explore today.

sections.heading: People & everyday life
paragraphs: The planned collection will look beyond battles to the homes, work, journeys and relationships that shaped lives in the Norse world.

sections.heading: Belief & storytelling
paragraphs: Myth, saga and original storytelling will have room here, with clear distinctions between the surviving texts, historical interpretation and fiction.

sections.heading: Objects & discoveries
paragraphs: Future articles will connect places and objects with the questions they raise, linking readers to the evidence and further reading.

sections.heading: Listen while the pages take shape
paragraphs: Browse the episode archive for existing stories on these themes. The entries there are podcast episodes with published show notes, rather than articles.
